Inhibition zones of B. subtilis on solid LB medium by WAP‐8294A preparations from OH11 (WT) grown in GSS, 10% TSB or R2A media, at 30°C for 72 h, with serial dilutions of vancomycin (starting concentration 50 μg ml−1) as control.C. A standard curve of vancomycin concentrations versus inhibition zone diameters on solid LB medium and the derived equation, where X is the inhibition zone diameter, and Y is the concentration of vancomycin. The data were obtained from five repeated experiments.
